reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, spreadsheet access, batching and undo wrappers, but introduces separate group-note storage instead of using the existing notes model.

duplication.why: Category-selection queries and eligibility guards are repeated across six month-wide actions, with only fixed-tag parsing shared.

placement.why: Budget actions and handler registration belong in their existing modules, but adding category_groups.notes splits note ownership from the established notes subsystem.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, supporting schema and tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate eligibility changes across six implementations and reconcile two representations of group notes, while new unknown fields discard an existing goal_def type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The migration and actions.ts read category_groups.notes, bypassing the notes table used by notes/app.ts and group NotesButton consumers.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses the same hidden/template eligibility policy through SQL predicates in five actions and JavaScript conditions in copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: All six month-wide actions obtain group notes through the new category_groups.notes representation rather than the established notes model; no shared helper gains parameters or special-case branches.
